summary: Voice Assistant feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passing on /api/voice/intent (fast-path regex for profile/crossings/highlights/reels/gatherings/logout/ghost/smalltalk, LLM Claude Sonnet 5 fallback for long-tail phrasing, empty=400, unauth=401) and /api/voice/query/{name} (todays_highlights with correct singular/plural grammar, recent_crossings, my_founder_number non-founder path, founder_count claimed+remaining, my_stats, nonexistent=404). Frontend: FAB [data-testid=voice-fab] visible bottom-right on /feed (x=1848,y=928,56x56) and /discover; right-click opens [data-testid=voice-help-modal] with example commands list; FAB correctly hidden on landing route /.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 6297 lines — voice module (~230 lines) is a good candidate to move to backend/routers/voice.py to keep server.py under the 700-line guideline.
Fast-path regex map is evaluated linearly on every request (~34 patterns). Fine at current scale, but consider compiling patterns once at module import for micro-perf.
LLM fallback catches all exceptions and returns 200 with intent='unknown' — good UX but hides real errors. Consider logging.exception + a metric so silent LLM failures are observable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice feature is fully green. STT/TTS (Web Speech API) cannot be exercised via Playwright — only FAB visibility and help modal are covered. If future changes touch the fast-path regex map, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_voice_assistant.py (parametrized FAST_PATH_CASES).
